title: Safe Semantics, Unsafe Interpretations: Tackling Implicit Reasoning Safety in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to implicitly unsafe cross-modal triggers (seemingly innocuous image and text combinations) using a weighted combination of human judgment and automated GPT-4o assessment.
Assessing Large Vision-Language Models on cross-modal inputs that implicitly trigger offensive religious beliefs, evaluated via human review and automated GPT-4o scoring.
Assessing Large Vision-Language Models on cross-modal inputs that implicitly trigger political controversies, evaluated via human review and automated GPT-4o scoring.
